SELECT TRUNCATE ( sum( refund_amount ), 2 ) FROM base_refund br JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT log.patient_id FROM base_patient_origin_log log JOIN base_bill bb ON log.patient_id = bb.patient_id JOIN base_bill_pay bbp ON bbp.bill_id = bb.bill_id WHERE log.origin_id = #{originId} AND log.inservice = 1 ) t ON br.patient_id = t.patient_id
and DATE_FORMAT( br.refund_date, '%Y-%m-%d' ) >= DATE_FORMAT( #{startDate}, '%Y-%m-%d' )
and DATE_FORMAT( br.refund_date, '%Y-%m-%d' ) <= DATE_FORMAT( #{endDate}, '%Y-%m-%d' )

select br.refund_id from base_refund br join ( SELECT DISTINCT log.patient_id FROM base_patient_origin_log log JOIN base_bill bb ON log.patient_id = bb.patient_id JOIN base_bill_pay bbp ON bbp.bill_id = bb.bill_id JOIN base_patient bp ON bp.patient_id = log.patient_id WHERE log.origin_id = #{query.originId}
and concat( IFNULL( bp.`name`, '' ),IFNULL( bp.`mobile`, '' )) LIKE concat( concat( '%', #{query.condition} ), '%' )
AND log.inservice = 1 ) t on br.patient_id = t.patient_id where 1 = 1
and DATE_FORMAT( br.refund_date, '%Y-%m-%d' ) >= DATE_FORMAT( #{query.startDate}, '%Y-%m-%d' )
and DATE_FORMAT( br.refund_date, '%Y-%m-%d' ) <= DATE_FORMAT( #{query.endDate}, '%Y-%m-%d' )

SELECT bb.bill_id billId, bb.patient_id patientId, DATE_FORMAT( log.crt_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') relatedTime, bp.`name`, bp.mobile, DATE_FORMAT( bp.first_visit_date, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') firstVisitDate, DATE_FORMAT( bp.last_visit_date, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') lastVisitDate, DATE_FORMAT( bb.order_date, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') orderDate, bo.abbreviation abbreviation, be.employee_name employeeName, bti.item_name itemName, brd.refund_amount workload from base_refund_detail brd left join base_bill_detail bbd on bbd.bill_detail_id = brd.bill_detail_id left join base_bill bb on bb.bill_id = bbd.bill_id left join base_patient bp on bp.patient_id = bb.patient_id left join base_patient_origin_log log on log.patient_id = bp.patient_id left join base_organization bo on bo.org_id = bb.org_id left join base_treatment_process btp on btp.treatment_id = bb.treatment_id left join base_employee be on be.user_id = btp.registered_dentist_id left join base_tariff_info bti ON bti.item_id = bbd.item_id where brd.refund_id = #{refundId} and log.origin_id = #{originId}
